WITH gender_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    c.gender,
    COUNT(i.invoice_number) as invoice_count
  FROM Invoices i
  JOIN Orders o ON i.order_id = o.order_id
  JOIN Customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
  GROUP BY c.gender
),
overall_average AS (
  SELECT AVG(invoice_count) as avg_invoice_count
  FROM gender_counts
)
SELECT 
  AVG(gc.invoice_count) as average_invoice_count_above_average,
  AVG(gc.invoice_count - oa.avg_invoice_count) as average_excess_over_overall_average
FROM gender_counts gc
CROSS JOIN overall_average oa
WHERE gc.invoice_count > oa.avg_invoice_count
